title: sendmail
summary: Create an email message using MATLAB sendmail-compatible arguments.

gpu_support.notes: Host-side compatibility builtin; GPU-resident inputs are gathered before execution.

description: Creates and sends a plain-text email message through a configured local transport or outbox capture path.
behaviors: Accepts scalar, string-array, or cell-array recipients plus subject and body text.
Writes RFC822-style messages to RUNMAT_SENDMAIL_OUTBOX when configured.
On native hosts, uses RUNMAT_SENDMAIL_COMMAND or /usr/sbin/sendmail when available.
Reports a clear error when only SMTP preferences are configured because direct TLS SMTP transport is not available in this build.
